text: New Connection and Re-Verification KYC Procedure Document ID: SOP_C17_KYC_VERIFICATION Category: C17 — KYC & Identity Verification Department: Compliance Customer Scope: all Version: 1.0 Last Updated: 2026-08-08 Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base Purpose To ensure all new connections and periodic re-verifications meet regulatory KYC standards. Scope Applies to all channels and customer segments unless a specific exception is noted below. Preconditions Customer identity verified (registered number and OTP where applicable). Account is active and not under a fraud, legal, or compliance hold. Roles & Responsibilities Required Information Registered mobile number / account ID. Nature of the request and any reference numbers already issued. Relevant transaction or ticket ID, where applicable. Procedure Collect one Proof of Identity and one Proof of Address from the approved document list. For Aadhaar-based e-KYC, obtain explicit customer consent before OTP-based verification. For video-KYC, complete the liveness check, geo-tag capture, and document-to-face match. Reject and request re-submission if any document is illegible, expired, or mismatched. Store verification records per the data retention schedule in Policy_C19_privacy_policy. Decision Points If the request qualifies under standard criteria, proceed with automatic processing. If suspected fraud indicators are present at any step, halt standard processing and route per the Fraud & Security Response SOP. Exception Handling Cases outside standard scope require supervisor sign-off before proceeding. Validation Confirm the account/system reflects the expected end state before the case is closed, and obtain customer confirmation where applicable. Escalation Where first-line steps do not resolve the issue within the stated timeframe, the case is escalated
title: New Connection and Re-Verification KYC Procedure
